name: LlamaIndex
tagline: Data framework for LLM-powered search and retrieval
description: LlamaIndex (formerly GPT Index) is an open-source data framework for building LLM applications over custom data. It specialises in ingesting, structuring, and retrieving data for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) workflows. LlamaIndex provides 100+ data connectors (PDFs, databases, APIs, websites), advanced indexing strategies, query engines, and evaluation tools. LlamaCloud (the managed service) handles production-grade parsing and indexing.
pricingDetails: LlamaIndex OSS: free. LlamaCloud: free tier, $30/month, Enterprise: custom.
